svg.aria-label: Resolve. Where rules can help with HR requests, and where a person must decide. A request is checked against policy rules. A routine request becomes a prepared response that waits for human review. A sensitive request, or one with no matching policy, is escalated to a person. A manipulation attempt is refused with no HR action.
